svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Video streaming system design
svg.desc: Video streaming system design. 14 components. Connections: Clients to API gateway (HTTPS API); API gateway to Upload service (get upload URL); Upload service to Metadata service (create video); Clients to Raw uploads (PUT pre-signed URL); Raw uploads to Transcode jobs (upload complete); Raw uploads to Transcoding workers (source file); Transcode jobs to Transcoding workers (poll); Transcoding workers to Processed storage (HLS/DASH renditions); Transcoding workers to Metadata service (ready); API gateway to Metadata service (watch page); Metadata service to Redis (lookup); Metadata service to Metadata DB (on miss); Metadata service to Search (index); API gateway to Search (query); API gateway to Recommendations (home feed); API gateway to view-events (produce); view-events to Recommendations (watch history); Clients to CDN edge (HLS segments); CDN edge to Processed storage (cache miss).

text.tspan: Uploads go straight to object storage; workers transcode a bitrate ladder that viewers stream as HLS segments from the CDN
